issues.where: rise cover, frames 1562-1566, whole sky and sun
issues.what: in three frames the sky goes from a blue starfield to a dark brown haze, the stars disappear and the sun dims to nothing while the horizon jumps from flat to a strong arch; color, exposure and horizon do not carry across the cover
issues.fix: spread the sky and sun change over the whole climb (20+ frames), keep the starfield and the sun's position and brightness locked to the camera, and ease the horizon curvature with altitude

issues.where: dive cover, frames 1318-1320, lower two thirds
issues.what: sharp lit cloud tops snap in over the blurred streaks as a cross-dissolve instead of coming out of the motion blur as the camera slows; frames 1309-1310 also show repeated parallel bands on the right, so the blur splits into ghost copies
issues.fix: tie blur length to camera speed so detail sharpens as the descent eases, use one continuous cloud layer through the cover instead of a dissolve, and raise the motion-blur sample count

issues.where: terrain segment, frames 1350-1529, foreground clouds vs horizon
issues.what: the horizon and sun stay fixed while the near cloud towers change shape in place; there is barely any parallax between near ground and horizon, so the clouds swim instead of passing under the camera. Frames 1333-1349 on sheet-02 are almost frozen
issues.fix: give the camera a slow forward drift so near clouds move clearly faster than the far band, and slow the cloud evolution so shapes keep their form as they travel

issues.what: detailed clouds turn into a uniform smear in one step while the horizon flattens and drops; the climb starts with a jump in speed instead of an eased start
issues.fix: ease the rise speed up from zero over the first frames and let the blur build with it

issues.what: the planet now has its bright limb and lit hemisphere on the right, but in the hold (sheet-01) it was lit from the left; with no orbit around the planet in the move, the light seems to flip
issues.fix: keep the sun direction the same in world space and frame the departure so the terminator matches the arrival, or show the camera moving around the planet

issues.where: hold, frames 1124-1164, Milky Way band left and right of the planet
issues.what: the brightness and contrast of the background band change from frame to frame while the camera is nearly still
issues.fix: lock the background exposure and turn off adaptive exposure during holds

issues.what: the cloud bands and the swirl barely rotate over 150 frames, so the globe looks frozen
issues.fix: add a slow, visible rotation or flow of the cloud bands during the hold
